templates.title: ACORN NUTS
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-PAINT NOT PROTECTED FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED ACORN NUTS
-SANDED DOWN TO BARE METAL
-PRIMED AND SET TO DRY
-REPAINTED AND SET TO DRY
-REVERSE INSTALLED

templates.title: SILVER TRIMS
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-EDGES NOT GRINDED DOWN FROM FACTORY
-CORRECTION:
-REMOVED SILVER TRIMS
-PLACED TRIMS IN VICE
-USED GRINDER TO SMOOTH OUT SHARP EDGES
-REVERSE INSTALLED

templates.title: INTAKE PANEL
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-PAINT DAMAGED FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED SCREWS SECURING PANEL
-REMOVED VENT
-REMOVED SILVER HANDLE
-SANDED DOWN PANEL TO BARE METAL
-PRIMED AND SET TO DRY
-REPAINTED AND SET TO DRY
-REVERSE INSTALLED

templates.title: BLACK TRIMS
templates.body:

-PAINT DAMAGE FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED SCREWS SECURING TRIMS
-SANDED DOWN TRIMS TO BARE METAL

-REPAINTED AND SET TO DRY
-REVERSE INSTALLED

templates.title: ENTRY HANDLES
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-SCUFFED WHEN INSTALLED
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED 4 SCREWS SECURING HANDLE
-PLACED HANDLE IN VICE
-USED A SCUFF PAD TO SAFELY GRIND DOWN ALL SHARP GROOVES
-REPEATED PROCESS FOR SECOND HANDLE
-REVERSE INSTALLED

templates.title: AIR LEAK PLUG
templates.body:
CAUSE
-NOT ENOUGH THREAD SEALENT APPLIED FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-EMPTIED CORRESPONDING AIR TANK
-REMOVED PLUG FROM TANK
-CLEANED THREADS
-APPLIED HIGH TEMP SEALENT ON THREADS
-REVERSE INSTALLED PLUG
-TESTED FOR LEAKS

templates.title: AIR LEAK LINE
templates.body:
CAUSE
-NOT ENOUGH THREAD SEALENT APPLIED FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-EMPTIED CORRESPONDING AIR TANK
-DISCONNECTED AIR LINE FROM FITTING
-CUT END OF LINE FLUSH TO PROVIDE BEST CONNECTION TO COUPLER
-REMOVED FITTING
-CLEANED THREADS
-APPLIED THREAD SEALENT
-REVERSE INSTALLED AND LEAK TESTED

templates.title: ACCESSORY VALVE LEAK
templates.body:
CAUSE
-NOT ENOUGH THREAD SEALENT APPLIED FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-EMPTIED AIR TANK
-REMOVED AIR LINES GOING TO VALVE
-REMOVED 2 BOLTS SECURING ACCESSORY VALVE
-REMOVED ALL 7 FITTING ON VALVE
-CLEANED THREADS AND APPLIED NEW THREAD SEALENT
-CUT END OF LINE FLUSH TO PROVIDE BEST CONNECTION TO COUPLER
-REVERSE INSTALLED AIR LINES AND LEAK TESTED

templates.title: AIR HORN PEDAL LEAK
templates.body:
CAUSE
-NOT ENOUGH THREAD SEALENT APPLIED FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-EMPTIED AIR TANK
-REMOVED 4 SCREWS SECURING PEDAL
-REMOVED FITTING FROM PEDAL VALVE
-CLEANED THREADS AND APPLIED NEW THREAD SEALENT
-CUT END OF LINE FLUSH TO PROVIDE BEST CONNECTION TO COUPLER
-REVERSE INSTALLED AND LEAK TESTED

templates.title: REFLECTIVE TAPE PEELING
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-AREA NOT CLEANED BEFORE INSTALLED
CORRECTION:
-APPLIED HEAT TO DECAL TO REMOVE WITHOUT DAMAGING PAINT
-CLEANED AREA WITH ALCOHOL TO REMOVE RESIDUE
-REAPPLIED #FT OF NEW TAPE AND SET TO CURE

templates.title: SEAT BOLTS
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-BOLT HOLES NOT DRILLED STRAIGHT FROM FACTORY NOT ALLOWING BOLT TO SIT LEVEL
-CORRECTION:
-REMOVED SEAT BOLT
-PRE DRILLED HOLE TO ALIGN BOLT STRAIGHT
-REVERSE INSTALLED AND TORQUED TO SPEC
-REPEAT PROCESS FOR # OF BOLTS

templates.title: WINDOWS NOT CLEARING 12INCHES
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-WINDOW STOPPERS NOT ALLOWING WINDOW TO GO DOWN FAR ENOUGH
CORRECTION:
-DRILLED CENTER OF STOPPER
-USED CHISEL TO REMOVE CENTER RIVET ROD
-APPLIED SEALENT TO FILL HOLE PROVIDING PROPER WEATHER SEAL
-REPEAT PROCESS FOR OTHER SIDE OF WINDOW
-REPEAT PROCESS FOR ALL WINDOWS

templates.title: VENTS HARD TO SWIVEL
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-EXCESS PLASTIC FROM MOLDING PROCESS NOT ALLOWING VENT TO SWIVEL EASILY
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED VENT FROM VEHICLE
-USED A SMALL FILE TO REMOVE EXCESS PLASTIC FROM SWIVEL AREA
-REVERSE INSTALLED

templates.title: DAYLIGHT DOOR
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-WEATHER STRIP FROM FACTORY TOO THIN
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED OLD WEATHER STRIP
-CLEANED AREA WITH ALCOHOL TO REMOVE RESIDUE
-APPLIED NEW WEATHER STRIP AND SET TO CURE

templates.title: FLIP SEAT SHOCKS
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-EXCESS THREAD ON SHOCK BOLT
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED SHOCK FROM SEAT
-CUT EXCESS THREAD TO ALLOW PROPER FITMENT
-REVERSE INSTALLED

templates.title: ENTRY STEP EXCEEDS 17INCHES
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-SPACERS TOO THICK FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-LIFTED VEHICLE USING COLUMN LIFTS
-USED JACKS TO SUPPORT CHASSIS RELIEVING PRESSURE FROM SUSPENSION
-REMOVED 4 U BOLTS SECURING ONE SIDE OF AXLE
-REMOVED SPACERS AND REVERSE INSTALLED SHORTER ONES
-LOWERED AXLE BACK INTO PLACE
-REVERSE INSTALLED NEW U BOLTS ALONG WITH NEW HARDWARE
-REPEAT PROCESS FOR OTHER SIDE
-ALLOWED VEHICLE TO SETTLE
-TORQUED U BOLTS TO SPEC
-MEASURED ENTRY STEP TO VERIFY

templates.title: STEP LIGHTS SCRATCHED
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-DAMAGED FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED STEP LIGHT
-REVERSE INSTALLED NEW STEP LIGHT

templates.title: BRAKE LINE LEAKING
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-IMPROPER INSTALLATION FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED BRAKE LINE
-CLEANED THREADS
-APPLIED HIGH TEMP THREAD SEALENT
-REVERSE INSTALLED AND LEAK TESTED

templates.title: E DOOR DOESNT MEET 12INCH REQUIREMENT
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-SEAT INSTALLED TOO FAR BACK
-CORRECTION:
-REMOVED SEAT BOLTS SECURING SEAT TO FLOOR
-REMOVED BOTH SIDE BOLTS ON GUSSET TRIM
-ONCE SEAT REMOVED MARKED HOLE LOCATIONS 1INCH FORWARD
-PRE DRILLED NEW HOLES
-REVERSE INSTALLED SEAT AND TORQUED TO SPEC
-REPEAT PROCESS FOR OTHER SIDE BOLTS
-REPEAT PROCESS FOR GUSSET TRIM BOLTS
-MEASURED E DOOR TO VERIFY
-APPLIED SEALENT TO FILL OLD HOLE LOCATIONS

templates.title: PEDAL ADJUSTER LINE KINKED
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-IMPROPER INSTALLATION FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-REMOVED PEDAL ADJUSTER LINE
-ROUTED LINE PROPERLY
-SECURED LINE ON BOTH ENDS USING P CLAMPS TO PREVENT LINE FROM KINKING AGAIN

templates.body:
CAUSE:
-NOT INSTALLED FROM FACTORY
-CORRECTION:
-CLEANED AREA WITH ALCOHOL TO REMOVE DIRT AND RESIDUE
-APPLIED SILICONE TO TOE AREA
-SET TO CURE

templates.title: SLOPPY SILICONE BEHIND TRIANGLE KIT
templates.body:
CAUSE:
SLOPPY SILICONE FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
REMOVED TRIANGLE KIT
-REMOVED SLOPPY SILICONE USING PLASTIC SCRAPER
-CLEANED AREA WITH ALCOHOL TO REMOVE RESIDUE
-REAPPLIED SILICONE NEATLY AROUND TRIANGLE KIT
-SET TO CURE

templates.title: SEAT BARRIER LEGS PAINT DAMAGE
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-PAINT DAMAGED FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-MASKED OFF AREA TO PREVENT OVERSPRAY
-SANDED DOWN TO BARE METAL
-PRIMED AND SET TO DRY
-REPAINTED AND SET TO DRY

templates.body:

CORRECTION:

-APPLIED ADHESIVE TO SECURE COVER
-REVERSE INSTALLED AND SET TO CURE

templates.body:
CAUSE:

-REVERSE INSTALLED

templates.title: WIRE CHANNELS FALLING OFF
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-DEFORMED CHANNELS FROM FACTORY CAUSING ENDS TO SAG
-CORRECTION;
-LIFT WIRE CHANNELS AND PUSH THEM INTO SILVER TRIMS TO SECURE THEM
-INSTALL PANHEAD SCREWS ALONG TOP TRIM TO PREVENT CHANNELS FROM FALLING OFF

templates.body:
CAUSE:

CORRECTION:

-CLEANED AND REMOVED SEALENT
-CUT SLIT IN PLASTIC HOUSING TO ALLOW HINGE TO MOVE FREELY
-REVERSE INSTALLED
-APPLIED NEW SEALENT AND SET TO CURE

templates.title: REAR E WINDOW OPENS WITH VANDAL LOCK ENGAGED
templates.body:
CAUSE:

CORRECTION:
-REMOVED E WINDOW HANDLE
-REMOVED AND REPLACED SPACER WITH THINNER ONE 
-REVERSE INSTALLED
-TESTED TO VERIFY VANDAL LOCK ENGAGES PROPERLY

templates.title: RUBRAIL END CAPS RUBBING ON E DOOR
templates.body:
CAUSE:
RUBRAIL TOO LONG FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-DRILLED RIVET HEAD
-USED PUNCH TO REMOVE CENTER RIVET ROD
-DRILLED THROUGH RIVET SHELL
-REPEAT PROCESS FOR BOTTOM RIVET
-REMOVED END CAP
-REMOVED ALL SCREWS SECURING RUB RAIL
-REMOVED RUB RAIL
-PLACED RUB RAIL IN VICE AND USED BAND SAW TO CUT END ENOUGH TO PROVIDE CLEARANCE
-REVERSE INSTALLED AND VERIFIED CLEARANCE

-REAPPLIED NEW SWRLF DECAL AND SET TO CURE

-WENT OVER SHARP EDGES WITH FILE TO FORM SMOOTH EVEN FINISH

templates.title: COOLANT CONTAMINATED
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-COOLANT CONTAMINATED FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-DRAINED COOLANT
-DRAINED COOLANT FROM PETCOCK VALVE ON RADIATOR
-REMOVED HEATER LINE AND PUSHED AIR THROUGH HEATER CORE TO COMPLETELY FLUSH SYSTEM
- REMOVED SURGE TANK AND FLUSHED REMOVING ANY RESIDUE
-VACUUM FILLED AND PRESSURE TESTED SYSTEM

templates.title: EXHAUST RUBBING ON BUMPER
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-EXHAUST NOT CENTERED IN BUMPER
CORRECTION:
-LOOSENED EXHAUST HANGER BRACKET
-LOOSENED BUMPER BOLTS
-ALIGNED EXHASUT AND BUMPER GIVING EXHAUST PIPE PROPER CLEARANCE
-SECURED BUMPER AND HANGER

templates.title: LINES RUBBING ON STEERING SHAFT
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-LINES NOT ROUTED CORRECTLY FROM FACTORY
CORRECTION:
-EMPTIED CORRESPONDING AIR TANK
-REMOVED AIR LINE FROM ACCESSORY VALVE
-ROUTED LINES AWAY FROM STEERING SHAFT TO PREVENT POTENTIAL HAZARD
-SECURED USING CABLE TIES

templates.title: REAR E DOOR VANDAL LOCK NOT SECURE
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-FASTENER MISSING
CORRECTION:
-MARKED PILOT HOLE WHERE SECOND FASTENER NEEDED
-REMOVED VANDAL LOCK HOUSING
-PRE DRILLED PILOT HOLE
-REVERSE INSTALLED WITH SECOND FASTENER TO SECURE PROPERLY

templates.title: VANDAL LOCK INTERMITTENT GROUNDING
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-VANDAL LOCK SWITCH GROUNDING OFF
CORRECTION:
-PINPOINTED WHICH SWITCH WAS CAUSING BUZZER TO SOUND BY PERFORMING A WIGGLE TEST ON HARNESSES
-PROBED WIRES TO VERIFY PROPER SIGNAL VOLTAGE
-VANDAL LOCK SWITCH SENDING GROUND SIGNAL AS IF IT WERE ENGAGED
-REMOVED VANDAL LOCK AND PLACED HEAT SHRINK OVER THE TOP PART INSERTED INTO FRAME
-REVERSE INSTALLED AND TESTED
-BUZZER NO LONGER BEING TRIGGERED

templates.title: PARK BRAKE
templates.body:
CAUSE:
-VEHICLE DRIVEN WITH PARK BRAKE ENGAGED
CORRECTION:
-PARKED VEHICLE ON LEVEL SURFACE AND CHOCKED WHEELS
-REMOVED 4 BOLTS SECURING DRIVELINE
-REMOVED CENTER BOLT SECURING END YOKE
-REMOVED 6 BOLTS SECURING DRUM TO END YOKE
-REMOVED 4 BOLTS SECURING PARK BRAKE ASSEMBELY
-REVERSE INSTALLED WITH NEW ASSMBELY AS WELL AS DRUMS
-TORQUED ALL HARDWARE TO SPEC AND ADJUSTED PARK BRAKE CABLE
